verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26996151 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318613 (dated 2026-01-20). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,500 pcs at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-02-20. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The delivery-terms note is internally inconsistent.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: the document says EXW Boise (buyer normally arranges and pays freight), but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. This means extra costs on the invoice that EXW would not normally include.
The document states DDP is not agreed, yet the Seller prepays duties and freight and charges them on the invoice.
The document has no issue date, no unit of measure for the quantity, and no line total.
observations: Clean printed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs.
The document has no issue date of its own. The only dates are the PO date (2026-01-20) and the confirmed delivery date (2026-02-20).
The quantity has no unit stated; 9,500 is read with the English comma as a thousands separator.
